meta.title: AD&D 2nd Edition Magical Items
meta.source: Magical item tables and descriptions (Appendix 2 and Appendix 3), owner-supplied PDF magic_items.pdf (67 pages)

conventions.roll: [from,to] on the table or subtable die. D100 00 = 100.
conventions.xp: XP Value is the number of experience points a character gets for making an item. null means the table shows a dash (no XP) or a marker (see xpMarker/footnotes).
conventions.xpPrinted: The XP cell exactly as printed.
conventions.classRestriction: Usable only by characters of the group named after the item (warrior, priest, wizard, rogue, druid).
conventions.nameMarker: Asterisks printed after an item name; meaning is in the table footnotes.
conventions.description: Items with hasDescription: true have their text in magic-item-descriptions.json under items[id]. An item with duplicateOf shares the description of that id. Tables printed inside a description may be flattened into the text.
conventions.weightLbs: Weight in pounds. Potions/oils and wands 0.1, rods 3.5, staves 5 (owner-set). Weapons take the weight of the named weapon in gear.json; null where the weapon type is not determinate or has no gear.json equivalent (never guessed). Where several gear.json items could apply (e.g. Arrow, Bolt) a value is given only if they all agree. Weights with weightSource 'owner-supplied (placeholder, may be revised)' were filled in from the owner's spreadsheet and may change; items still without weightLbs (types of sword, bow/crossbow, armour and shield not fixed, net, hornblade, hammer of thunderbolts, etc.) are left empty.
conventions.speedFactor: Weapons only. speedFactorBase = speed factor of the named weapon in gear.json; plus = the magical plus; speedFactor = speedFactorBase minus plus (owner rule, e.g. long sword 5 becomes 4 at +1). Minimum 0 (owner rule): a result below 0 is stored as 0. Table 108 entries have no plus yet, so only speedFactorBase is given and speedFactor is null until the plus is known. Ammunition has no speed factor. gearRef names the gear.json weapon(s) used; mappingAssumption flags a judgement.
conventions.armourWeight: Magical armour weighs the same as its mundane counterpart in gear.json (owner rule), referenced by gearRef. Empty where the base armour type is not fixed or has no gear.json equivalent.
conventions.extraItems: Items added by the owner that are not on the printed table (no die roll, roll null). source 'owner-added'. valueGp = gold piece value (new field; not printed on the tables). hasDescription false until description text is supplied.
conventions.variants: Items whose version is fixed once by a random roll are stored as one entry per possible version. Each variant row keeps the parent's table roll, has id = parent id + variant key, variantOf = parent id and variant = {die, roll [from,to] on the item's own die, label}. Variant xp, weightLbs, plus and speedFactor are filled where the item text gives them. The generic entry is removed. nameMarker footnotes about 'type determined by die roll' no longer apply to variant rows. Items not expanded are listed in variantsNotExpanded.
conventions.specialWeaponTypes: Table 110 items carry weaponTypeOptions (gear.json weapon ids the item can be) and weaponTypeSelection: 'fixed' (one option), 'choice' (the app shows a selector) or 'none' (no gear.json item, e.g. nets). plus is the item's magical plus (null where it varies or isn't stated; plusNote explains). weightLbs and speedFactorBase/speedFactor on 'choice' items are not fixed by the item: when a type is selected take weight and speedFactorBase from that gear.json weapon and speedFactor = max(0, speedFactorBase - plus). Sun Blade is a bastard sword in appearance and damage but its weight and speed factor are those of a short sword (gearRef shortSword) per its description. Owner choices: generic swords may be any of the 12 gear.json Sword-group items; hammers may be Warhammer, Warhammer (Thrown) or Warhammer, two-handed; Hornblade may be Knife, Dagger or Short sword; Buckle Knife is Knife; crossbows may be any of the five gear.json crossbows (hand, light, heavy, disk, doubled); Bow +1 may be short, long, composite short or composite long.
conventions.specialArmourTypes: Table 107 items carry armourTypeOptions (gear.json armour ids the item can be) and armourTypeSelection ('fixed' = one option, 'choice' = the app shows a selector). plus is the item's magical AC plus (null where it is not fixed); plusOptions lists the allowed values where the plus is a choice (Elven Chain Mail +1 to +5, owner-set; Plate Mail of Vulnerability -2, -3 or -4 per its description); plusNote explains. On 'choice' items weightLbs is not fixed by the item: take weight from the selected gear.json armour. Owner choices: Armor of Blending and Armor of Missile Attraction may be any of the 12 body armours except Red Dragon Scale Armour; Shield, Large is Shield, Body; Shield -1, Missile Attractor may be any of the four shields. The armour and shield type tables are not in the data files.
conventions.hasCharges: true on items that carry charges (from the item description, or the Table 91 ring footnote 'limited by the number of charges'). The field is absent on all other items. The number of charges is not stored: it varies by item and is to be recorded by the app.
conventions.container: type EquipmentContainer marks an item that holds other items, with capacity in the same form as gear.json equipment containers: weightLimitLbs, volume {dimensionsIn, printed, volumeCuIn}, count {max, of}, restriction (null = none or not supplied). compartments (new here) lists identical compartments as quantity x limits, for items that are several containers in one; the totals on capacity are the sum. A volume with derived true was calculated from stated dimensions. contentsCountForEncumbrance false (owner rule): anything placed inside does not add to encumbrance; only the item's own weight counts. Absent on other containers, which count their contents normally.

typos.Horn of Goodness (Evil): normalised to Horn of Goodness/Evil (the description heading reads Horn of Goodness/Evil)
typos.Weapon table 110 subtable B: Trident of Fish Command (50), Submission (1,50) and Warning (1,00) print truncated XP values and Trident of Yearning prints a dash; Spear, Cursed Backbiter has a blank. files.index: magic-items.json (this file): tables, XP, restrictions, support tables
files.descriptions: magic-item-descriptions.json: description text keyed by item id, general rule sections (generalRuleTitles[].key is the index into generalRules)

meta.removedByOwner: Tables 88, 90, 105, 106, 109, 111-119 and their related information were removed at the owner's request (category roll, scrolls, armour type and adjustment, attack roll adjustment, potion compatibility, spell failure, intelligent weapon tables, and the related general rules text). Smoke Powder (dusts.smokePowder, table 101) removed at the owner's request: it was only usable if the arquebus is allowed, and the arquebus was removed. Protection scrolls (name and XP only) were added back as a separate table 'protectionScrolls' by the owner.

variantsNotExpanded.perUseOrContents: Not expanded (outside the fixed-at-creation scope): Wand of Wonder, Iron Flask, Robe of Useful Items, Bag of Tricks, Beaker of Plentiful Potions, Necklace of Prayer Beads, Boots of Varied Tracks, Book of Infinite Spells, Crystal Ball, Figurines of Wondrous Power, Quaal's Feather Token, ring secondary-power tables (Clumsiness, Contrariness, Weakness), Spell Storing, Staff of Power.

tomItems.source: Tome of Magic Chapter 4 (owner-supplied PDF tomitems.pdf, 38 pages): Tables 4-13 and the item descriptions.
tomItems.placement: Merged into the matching existing tables as extraItems (roll null, source TOM); no Tome of Magic dice rolls are stored (owner choice).
tomItems.xp: As printed in the Tome of Magic tables; a dash is stored as null with xpPrinted '--'.
tomItems.classRestriction: Table markers P = priest, W = wizard, Wr = warrior; (P,W) = priest and wizard.
tomItems.weights: Owner-set only: aromatic oils, oils and potions 0.1 lb, wands 0.1, rod 3.5, staff 5. No other weights given.
tomItems.variants: Split into one entry per version fixed at creation (owner choice): Potion of Elemental Control (4), Oil of Elemental Plane Invulnerability (16), Ring of Affliction (8), Ring of Elemental Metamorphosis (4), Ring of Fortitude (3), Ring of Randomness (7), Ring of Resistance (8), School Cap (8), Amulet of Magic Resistance (12: strength 5-30% x all spells or 1st-6th only), Bag of Bones (2), Disintegration Chamber (6 sizes), Teleportation Chamber (6 sizes). The generic entry is not stored. Each variant has its own description copy.
tomItems.tablePlacement: Table 9 items are placed by item type: Bracers and Gloves in the boots/bracers/gloves table, Fur of Warmth and Robe in cloaks and robes, School Cap in girdles/hats/helms; Table 12: Horn of Valor in instruments, the rest in household items.
notes: Oils of Elemental Plane Invulnerability (table name) is stored as Oil of Elemental Plane Invulnerability (the description heading).
Table 8 and Table 13 items follow the printed names.
Trimia's Catalogue of Outer Plane Artifacts: the plane devices are per-use content and are not split.
The Tome of Magic PDF lost fraction glyphs in two places; owner confirmed: Amulet of Extension '1½ rounds' and '1¼ rounds'; Warp Marble '(½-inch diameter)'. Descriptions corrected.
